svg.title: How each of the six styles quotes a word
svg.desc: en: curly quotes, either pair. fr: guillemets with a no-break space inside, U+00A0 or U+202F, whichever the document uses (Imprimerie nationale). es: guillemets closed up (RAE). de-DE: guillemets closed up, pointing inward (Duden). de-CH: guillemets closed up, pointing outward (Duden). nl: either pair of curly quotes, one per document (Taalunie).
